description: Repo-scale (c-jobqueue): pausing the scheduler must cascade across submit, run_next, and retry
prompts: Add a `paused` field to Scheduler (default 0) plus `scheduler_pause`/`scheduler_resume`. Add `int scheduler_retry(Scheduler *s, int id)`: moves a FAILED history entry back into the pending queue (assigning it a fresh id) for another attempt, returning the new id, or -1 if the job isn't FAILED. Pausing must cascade across THREE places, all rejecting new work while paused: (1) `scheduler_submit` must return -1 while paused; (2) `scheduler_run_next` must return 0 while paused, even with jobs pending; (3) `scheduler_retry` must ALSO return -1 while paused - retries are a form of new work and must be held back too, not just the two original submission paths.
name: add_c_jobqueue_pause_cascade
